newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PSE REINSTATES EKOAGROBANKA MEMBERSHIP.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PSE REINSTATES EKOAGROBANKA MEMBERSHIP.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange on Monday said it had reinstated the full bourse membership of bank Ekoagrobanka.
The PSE added in a statement that it had also accepted three other brokerages -- Conseq Finance, Evropska, and P&P Brokers -- as members.

The PSE had suspended the bank's membership earlier this year after the troubled institution was placed under forced administration in January by the Czech National Bank after reports of financial problems led customers to queue to withdraw deposits.
The CNB cut the bank's basic capital by 600 million crowns to 1.2 million crowns in order to pay off existing obligations.
In late June, Union Banka, another Czech bank, took over Ekoagrobanka.
